description: The ACM-68000 signal for a listed security in its home market: ACM-200 TRADING (on the register), ACM-404 NOT ON THE REGISTER, ACM-451 READ THE FILING (a regulatory filing in the last three days, named), ACM-300 CONDITIONAL (a bare ticker names more than one issuer: add the exchange), ACM-000 NOT APPLICABLE (a GTIN: ask gtinfetch.ai), ACM-500 SYSTEM ERROR (the home node did not answer). ACM-403 HALTED is advisory: the nodes carry no halt flag yet, so the answer links the market's halts page. Each signal has its page at https://acm-<code>.ai/.

identifier.description: ISIN (best), ticker with exchange (TSX:SHOP, SHEL.L), LEI or CMR key.
